name: factorial
source:
import Base
def fact(+n: Nat) -> U32:
  match n:
    case 0n: 1
    case 1n+p: U32.mul(U32.from_nat(n), fact(p))
def main() -> U32:
  fact(7n)

name: array-depth
source:
